<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv
import os

# Read input
input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
meta_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in meta_cols]

total_rows = len(df)

# Compute missingness per indicator
report_rows = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = int(df[col].isna().sum())
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows if total_rows > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    report_rows.append({
        "indicator": col,
        "missing_count": missing_count,
        "missing_rate": missing_rate,
        "kept": kept
    })

# Write missingness report
report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_rows)
report_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv", index=False)

# Determine kept indicators
kept_indicators = [r["indicator"] for r in report_rows if r["kept"]]

# Write selected matrix
selected_cols = meta_cols + kept_indicators
df[selected_cols].to_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv", index=False)

print("Done. Kept indicators:", kept_indicators)
print("Report written to outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv")
print("Selected matrix written to outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
</solution_file>

import pandas as pd
import csv
import os

# Read input
input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
meta_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in meta_cols]

total_rows = len(df)

# Compute missingness per indicator
report_rows = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = int(df[col].isna().sum())
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows if total_rows > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    report_rows.append({
        "indicator": col,
        "missing_count": missing_count,
        "missing_rate": missing_rate,
        "kept": kept
    })

# Write missingness report
report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_rows)
report_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv", index=False)

# Determine kept indicators
kept_indicators = [r["indicator"] for r in report_rows if r["kept"]]

# Write selected matrix
selected_cols = meta_cols + kept_indicators
df[selected_cols].to_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv", index=False)

print("Done. Kept indicators:", kept_indicators)

print("Selected matrix written to outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
